title: Soja asghar jaani soja
body:
Soja asghar jaani soja
Ghar me nahi hai paani soja
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim bhi parlok sidhaare, auno mohammed bhi gaye maare
sogaye jaake nadiya kanaare, aaya na ab tak paani soja
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ne tere bhaale khaaye, tere chacha ne haath kataaye
mashke sakina chid gayi beta, beh gaya saara paani soja
<<DIVIDER>>
teen dino ka tu hai bhooka, teen dino ka tu hai pyaasa
kumbhla gaya hai mukhda tera, sookh gaya hai paani soja
<<DIVIDER>>
nadiya kanaare shatru ki sena, hukm hai koi paani na lena
paani ke badle khoon bahaa par, laaya na koi paani soja
<<DIVIDER>>
maata pita ki ankhio ke taare, phoot hai ab bhaag hamaare
karbal ban me gham ke maare, doodh hai aur na paani soja
<<DIVIDER>>
apni ye biphta kis ko sunaau, teri ye haalath kisko dikhaau
haaye kaha'n se paani mai laau, laau kaha'n se paani soja
